narrative.synopsis: Persephone’s return is real but incomplete. Hades’ pomegranate makes reunion conditional, creating the divided rhythm between underworld marriage and Demeter’s upper-world joy.
narrative.openingSituation: Zeus has ordered Persephone’s release from Hades.
narrative.centralConflict: A small act of eating carries cosmic consequences for mother, daughter, and seasons.
narrative.resolution: Persephone returns but is bound to come back below.
narrative.outcome: The year is divided, explaining recurring loss and renewal.
